beliefs: The box reverses the order of characters in the input string [E1]
Reversal preserves case, digits, punctuation, and spaces exactly, only order changes [E1]
Whitespace-only strings map to empty string [E2]
Leading spaces (0x20) are stripped from the input before reversal, but tabs and newlines are not [E8, E9]
Trailing whitespace of all kinds is stripped from the input before reversal [E6, E7, E10]
After reversal, leading whitespace of all kinds is stripped from the result [E7, E10]
Equivalently: strip trailing whitespace (all kinds), reverse, then strip leading whitespace (all kinds) from the result [E10]
notes: E6 confirms trailing whitespace (all kinds) is stripped before reversal; E7-E10 show leading stripping only removes spaces before reversal but all whitespace after reversal. Changed predict to lstrip(' ') then rstrip() then reverse then lstrip().
